# `⍺` — Left argument

`⍺` is the current dfn's left argument. In a call with one argument it is absent, and drops out of the expression that uses it, as [dfns](../dfns.qmd#arguments) describes: `{⍺-⍵}3` is `¯3`.

```bpl
10{⍺-⍵}3           ⍝ 7
```

`⍺←expression` supplies a lazy default, evaluated only on monadic calls.

```bpl
{⍺←2 ⋄ ⍺×⍵}3       ⍝ 6
4{⍺←2 ⋄ ⍺×⍵}3      ⍝ 12
```
